questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
In y=5x+4, what does the slope represent?
A) y increases by 5 for each 1-unit increase in x
B) y starts at 5
C) x increases by 4 for each unit of y
D) y is always 9

options.A: y increases by 5 for each 1-unit increase in x
options.B: y starts at 5
options.C: x increases by 4 for each unit of y

questions.explanation: Slope is the change in y per unit change in x.
